configurations.name: skull-game
runtimeArgs: $listener = New-Object System.Net.HttpListener; $listener.Prefixes.Add('http://localhost:3000/'); $listener.Start(); Write-Host 'Server started on port 3000'; while ($listener.IsListening) { $ctx = $listener.GetContext(); $req = $ctx.Request; $res = $ctx.Response; $path = $req.Url.LocalPath -replace '^/', ''; if ($path -eq '' -or $path -eq '/') { $path = 'index.html' }; $file = Join-Path 'C:\Users\seo94\Desktop\Python GUI 3.7\skull' $path; if (Test-Path $file) { $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($file); $ext = [System.IO.Path]::GetExtension($file); $mime = @{'.html'='text/html';'.js'='application/javascript';'.css'='text/css';'.png'='image/png';'.ttf'='font/ttf';'.otf'='font/otf'}[$ext]; if (-not $mime) { $mime = 'application/octet-stream' }; $res.ContentType = $mime; $res.ContentLength64 = $bytes.Length; $res.OutputStream.Write($bytes, 0, $bytes.Length) } else { $res.StatusCode = 404 }; $res.Close() }
